name: pitwall
description: A native terminal multiplexer for coding agents, with live status and persistent sessions.
readme_summary: Pitwall is a desktop terminal application designed for managing multiple AI coding agents simultaneously. It provides a visual overview of each agent's status, highlights tasks requiring attention, and allows for quick navigation and interaction with agents directly from the interface or a paired mobile device.
key_features: Run multiple coding agents in separate tabs and split panes.
Sidebar displays agent status (Working, Input, Approval, Plan, Done, Error), branch, and changes.
Quickly jump to agents needing attention with keyboard shortcuts and desktop notifications.
Approve or deny prompts and answer questions directly from the sidebar or a paired phone.
Review code changes, add comments, and send feedback to agents.
Assign each agent its own git worktree to prevent file editing collisions and manage ports.
Installable via Homebrew, Scoop, or a convenience script.
primary_use_case: Managing and interacting with multiple AI coding agents efficiently within a single desktop interface.
cover_image_prompt: A conductor leading a symphony orchestra, where each musician represents an AI coding agent. The conductor, embodying 'pitwall', uses a glowing baton to direct the flow of code and tasks, with sheet music on their stand showing real-time status updates like 'Working', 'Approval Needed', and 'Done'. Subtle digital particles representing data streams flow between the conductor and the musicians. The background is a clean, modern studio with soft, focused lighting. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration, emphasizing organization and control over complex, parallel processes. The 'pitwall' logo is subtly integrated into the conductor's podium.

name: VideoCutter
description: Download only the part you want from YouTube & 1000+ sites (MP4, GIF, MP3). Free Windows app built on yt-dlp & FFmpeg.
readme_summary: VideoCutter is a free, open-source Windows application that allows users to download specific segments of online videos from YouTube and over 1000 other sites. It supports downloading as video (MP4, GIF) or audio (MP3) without requiring a separate video editor.
key_features: Download specific video/audio clips from 1000+ sites
Frame-accurate trimming with preview
Export formats: MP4, GIF, MP3, MKV, WEBM, MOV, AVI, WAV, FLAC, M4A, OGG, OPUS
Vertical/square aspect ratios for social media
Automatic silence and sponsored segment removal (YouTube)
Download queue and playlist support
Built on yt-dlp and FFmpeg
No account or tracking required
primary_use_case: Downloading specific clips or segments from online videos (e.g., YouTube) as video or audio files.
cover_image_prompt: A digital scissors meticulously cutting a vibrant stream of video data flowing from a computer monitor. The scissors are precisely snipping out a small, highlighted segment of the video stream, while the rest flows past. On the monitor's screen, a simplified timeline shows the start and end points being selected. Small icons representing different output formats like MP4, GIF, and MP3 float near the cut segment. The background is a clean, modern workspace with subtle digital particles. The overall mood is efficient and precise. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with clear, bold colors and a focus on the cutting action.

name: gander
description: Take a gander at any file. Offline, zero-permission Android viewer for PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, ODT, RTF, ZIP, STL, photos, video, audio, Markdown and code.
readme_summary: Gander is a lightweight, open-source Android application designed to view a wide variety of file types directly on the device. It prioritizes user privacy and offline functionality by requiring zero permissions and having no internet access, ads, or trackers.
key_features: Universal file viewing (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, images, video, audio, Markdown, code, ZIP)
100% offline functionality
Zero permissions required
No ads or trackers
Small APK size (~5 MB)
ZIP archive browsing without extraction
Pinch zoom and smooth scrolling
Recent files with thumbnail previews
Folder browsing
Share sheet and 'Open with' integration
Find in document feature
primary_use_case: To provide Android users with a private, offline, and comprehensive solution for viewing diverse file types without relying on cloud services or granting unnecessary permissions.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, anthropomorphic goose character ('Gander') wearing a monocle, holding a magnifying glass to a diverse pile of digital documents and media files (PDFs, spreadsheets, images, videos, code snippets). The goose is in a cozy, offline-themed room, with no visible internet connection or external devices. Subtle digital particles representing data flow are contained within the magnifying glass's view. The background shows a clean, organized digital library. The overall mood is secure and self-contained. The art style should be a charming 3D isometric illustration with soft lighting and a clean, friendly color palette, emphasizing the 'Gander' name subtly on a small signpost.

name: DevProjex
description: Build safe, token-efficient codebase context for LLMs, AI chats, and coding agents — local-first GUI, TUI, CLI, and a read-only MCP server with Smart Ignore, secret/PII redaction, Git scopes, and code compression.
readme_summary: DevProjex is a versatile tool designed to create clean, token-efficient codebase context for AI models and coding agents. It offers multiple interfaces (GUI, TUI, CLI) and a read-only MCP server, ensuring privacy and control over what data is shared with AI.
key_features: Builds safe, token-efficient codebase context for LLMs, AI chats, and coding agents
Local-first GUI, TUI, and CLI interfaces
Read-only MCP server for AI agents
Smart Ignore, secret/PII redaction, and Git scopes
Code compression and token optimization
Live preview with token estimates
Export context as ASCII, Markdown, JSON, XML, folder, or ZIP
Read-only and telemetry-free by design
primary_use_case: To prepare and provide secure, optimized codebase context for AI models and coding agents, ensuring privacy and efficiency.
cover_image_prompt: A meticulous librarian carefully selecting specific books from a vast, overflowing library. Each selected book is then placed into a transparent, glowing containment field, revealing its contents as clean, organized text snippets and code blocks. The librarian uses a special magnifying glass that highlights sensitive information, which is then automatically masked with a digital redaction effect before entering the field. The library shelves subtly resemble code repositories, and small digital particles representing tokens flow around the containment field, indicating its optimized size. The overall mood is one of secure, precise knowledge transfer. The scene is rendered in a clean, 3D isometric illustration style with a focus on clarity and a palette of blues, greens, and subtle digital glows.

name: Dynamic-Island-Win11
readme_summary: Dynamic Island for Windows 11 is a Rust-based application that brings Apple's Dynamic Island feature to Windows. It displays music playback information, synchronized lyrics, and other media controls in a compact, animated bar at the top of the screen, with options for customization and integration with various music players.
key_features: Displays music playback info (artist, title, album art) from Spotify, Yandex Music, browsers, AIMP, VLC, and other players.
Provides media controls: pause, skip, scrub.
Synchronized lyrics from Spotify, Yandex Music, and LRCLIB, with click-to-seek functionality.
Smooth, springy animations with accent colors derived from album art and an equalizer visualizer.
Low memory and CPU usage.
Hides in fullscreen games/videos and shrinks to a thin bar over browsers.
Works entirely locally without servers.
Customizable settings via a TOML configuration file.
primary_use_case: To replicate the Apple Dynamic Island experience on Windows 11, enhancing music and media playback by providing at-a-glance information and controls.
cover_image_prompt: A stylized, minimalist representation of a Windows 11 desktop. At the very top center, a sleek, glowing 'island' shape hovers, similar to Apple's Dynamic Island. Inside this island, a miniature album cover is visible, with subtle animated equalizer bars pulsing gently. Below the island, a translucent screen displays synchronized song lyrics flowing smoothly. The overall mood is clean, modern, and slightly magical, with soft, ambient lighting. Small, subtle UI elements like play/pause icons and a progress bar are integrated into the island's design. The repository name 'Dynamic-Island-Win11' is subtly etched into the desktop background. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clarity and a soft, glowing aesthetic.

name: zeroshot
description: Runs coding agents as a graph: one agent implements, independent agents review, failures go to repair, and nothing ships until the checks pass. Works with Codex, Claude Code and Copilot. Bring your own topology.
readme_summary: Zeroshot is a Rust-based tool that orchestrates AI coding agents in a graph-based workflow. It separates code implementation from review and repair, ensuring that code is only shipped after independent agents have verified its quality. It supports various AI models like Codex, Claude Code, and Copilot.
key_features: Runs coding agents as a graph
Independent agents for implementation, review, and repair
Failures are routed to a repair loop
Code delivery requires passing checks from reviewers
Supports Codex, Claude Code, and Copilot
Allows users to define their own agent topologies
primary_use_case: Automating and improving the quality of AI-generated code through a multi-agent review and repair system.
cover_image_prompt: A meticulous robotic artisan carefully crafting a delicate glass sculpture, while a separate, impartial robotic inspector with a magnifying lens examines the sculpture from multiple angles. The artisan agent is shown with glowing tools, inputting raw digital material. The inspector agent highlights any imperfections with a red beam. Once approved, the sculpture emits a green aura and is placed on a pedestal labeled 'Zeroshot'. The background is a clean, modern workshop with subtle code snippets projected on the walls. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, futuristic aesthetic and a focus on the contrast between creation and verification.
